name: Perplexity Comet
description: Comet is a web browser from Perplexity with a built-in AI assistant that answers questions about pages, summarizes content and can perform tasks such as emailing, shopping or research while you browse. It is available for Mac, Windows, iOS and Android. Comet has been free to download and use since October 2025; an optional Comet Plus subscription costs $5/month and is included with Perplexity Pro and Max.

pricing.label: Free
pricing.note: Comet has been free to download and use since October 2025; an optional Comet Plus subscription costs $5/month and is included with Perplexity Pro and Max.

howToUse.title: Download Comet
howToUse.description: The Comet help center says to open the official download page and download the installer. The page suggests the Mac or Windows build.

howToUse.title: Install and sign in
howToUse.description: Run the installer, launch Comet, and sign in to your Perplexity account.

howToUse.title: Import your browser data
howToUse.description: The help article says to open Settings, choose Import bookmarks and settings, pick the previous browser, and select what to import.

howToUse.title: Ask or summarize the page
howToUse.description: The same help center says Comet uses Perplexity search and includes an Ask button for the open page and a Summarize button.
